frontmatter.name: explainer
frontmatter.description: Build cinematic, interactive explainers of computer-science concepts (invoked as /explainer <concept>) as real running simulations in a lit 3D world. A deterministic model of the concept (Raft really elects a leader, MapReduce really counts words, quicksort really sorts, the MMU really walks page tables) is narrated step by step, with a chapter scrubber that rewinds, captions, meters, failure scenarios, knobs, an inspector, a code panel and predict-the-next-step questions. Output: one self-contained HTML file, plus optional WebM/MP4 video and PNG stills. Use it whenever someone wants to explain, visualize, animate or teach how a CS concept works: distributed systems, consensus, operating systems, memory, caches, CPUs, databases, storage engines, networking, algorithms and data structures, compilers, concurrency, ML systems or security protocols, even if they only say "diagram", "figure", "animation" or "interactive". Not for concepts outside computing.

frontmatter.name: teacher
frontmatter.description: The words pass of an Explainer figure. Writes or revises lesson.mjs beside a figure.mjs (layered steps, chapter enter cards, a picture map, asks with per-option feedback) against the real run, then can run the review rounds. Use as /explainer:teacher <figure.mjs> to re-teach an existing figure, or when the explainer teacher agent loads it.

frontmatter.name: phronesis-cross-product-forecasting
frontmatter.description: Request, read, and verify cross-vertical forecasts from the Phronesis platform — decisions that live at the intersection of two verticals (e.g. AI/AGI x Regulatory, Energy x Compute, Climate x Supply-Chain). Use this skill when a decision depends on how two domains interact rather than on either alone.

frontmatter.name: freecad-addons
frontmatter.description: Use when creating, reviewing, refactoring, packaging, or debugging a FreeCAD addon for FreeCAD 1.1+ — workbenches, toolbar or menu extensions, importers, preferences, translations, FeaturePython document objects, properties, extensions, observers, or Pivy/Coin3D view providers. Covers the modern namespaced layout, package.xml metadata, commands, resources, testing, security, and release quality. Do NOT use for FreeCAD core C++ development or single-file macros.
